english.how_found: Course page 'English language requirement' section -> link 'English language requirements' (/study/apply/english-language/)
english.notes: Computing BEng requires the STANDARD level (not Higher). TOEFL iBT: 92 overall, min 20 per section for tests before 21 Jan 2026; tests from 21 Jan 2026 on the new 1-6 scale need 4.5 overall, min 4.5 in all elements. Duolingo 115 (min 105 subscores); PTE Academic 62 (min 56). Scores valid if taken within 2 years of course start. Quotes come from table cells flattened to text.

value.description: No published grade threshold for the Kazakhstan NIS Grade 12 certificate: it is not on the course's list of accepted international qualifications (list jumps from Italy to Latvia). Route is an accepted foundation programme (UCL UPCSE or Warwick IFP, 80% overall) or another accepted qualification (e.g. A-levels A*A*A-A*AAA with A* Maths; IB 41 with 7 HL Maths). TMUA admissions test is mandatory (no published cut-off).

gpa.quote: If your qualification is not included, it might not be accepted for entry. You can check with the relevant Admissions team for confirmation.

extra_quotes.quote: If your school qualification is not on the list of accepted qualifications, you may be considered by taking an accepted Foundation programme, or an accepted qualification at an external provider - see our course pages for details.
You must sit the Test for Mathematics for University Admission (TMUA) as part of the application process for this course.
If your TMUA test performance is sufficient, this will be considered in conjunction with your UCAS application form.
The Department of Computing minimum requirements are: 80% overall 80% Mathematics 80% Biology, Chemistry or Physics

gpa.how_found: Course page 'Entry requirements' > 'Other qualifications' > International qualifications dropdown (Kazakhstan absent); Russia and Central Asia region page 'How to apply (undergraduate)'
gpa.notes: Admission decided holistically: qualifications + mandatory TMUA + UCAS application; interviews at discretion. The 80% quote is the UCL UPCSE requirement. Applicant should confirm NIS status with Admissions.

deadline.quote: Application deadlines – Wednesday 13 January 2027 at 18.00 (UK time)
deadline.notes: UCAS deadline for October 2027 entry, 18:00 UK time. TMUA must also be sat: window 1 15-16 Oct 2026 (booking closed), window 2 8 Jan 2027 (booking 26 Oct - 21 Dec 2026).
